name: Hoshino Miruki
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c147195]Soratarou[/url]'s senior from his part-time job back when he was in high-school, and also his first love. A kind-hearted girl who he met at work after his sister's disappearance, her support was what helped him move on and work to better his life, and was what made him fall in love with her.
